description: Ministry of Power & Renewable Energy - Order made to approve the propsoed acquisitions of lands in Polpitiya, Ambagamuwa Korale D/S Division,  Nuwara Eliya District required by the Ceylon Electricity Board
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It is an order under the Ceylon Electricity Board Act approving the acquisition of specific lands described in detail (including location, extent, boundaries, and current use). While it mentions a minister's name and title, the core content focuses entirely on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government-related classification.
